analysis.title: SoFi Technologies Inc. (SOFI): 3Q26 First Take: Beat and raise and better than expected 2027 guidance
key_insights: SOFI reported 3Q26 adj revenue of $1,371mn, about 8% ahead of consensus. The beat came mainly from higher loan origination activity, which raised both net interest income and fair value origination gains in fee income.
Total loan originations were $16.9bn, 17% above consensus and 14% above GS estimate, driven mainly by personal loans ($12.6bn vs $10.1bn consensus).
Net interest income was $929.5mn, 9% above consensus. Net interest margin was 5.98%, 7 bps above consensus, helped by higher balances and better yield dynamics.
Adjusted EBITDA was $470mn, 6% ahead of consensus. GAAP net income was $241mn and GAAP EPS was $0.18, slightly ahead of consensus.
Marks as a percentage of loans fell sequentially. GS says this was offset by stronger originations and likely a benefit from interest rate hedging.

FY26 guidance was raised: adjusted net revenue ~$5.04bn (from ~$4.75-4.85bn), adjusted EBITDA ~$1.66bn (from ~$1.6bn), adjusted net income ~$840mn (from $825mn), adjusted diluted EPS ~$0.61 (from ~$0.60).

Initial FY27 guidance: adjusted net revenue ~$6.4bn, adjusted EBITDA ~$2.24bn, adjusted net income ~$1.28bn, adjusted diluted EPS ~$0.90. FY27 EPS is about 10% ahead of consensus of $0.82 (Visible Alpha).
GS believes sentiment was negative heading into the print and that SOFI faces no significant revenue or capital headwinds from higher rates. It expects the stock to trade well on the print.
CET1 capital fell to 16.9% from 18.7% in 2Q26, a decline of about 180 bps. GS lists capital levels as a call question.
GS maintains a Neutral rating with a $15 12-month price target (19x P/E on Q5-Q8 estimates) against a $14.46 price, 3.7% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS views the 3Q26 print as a beat and raise with better than expected FY27 guidance and expects the stock to trade well, but keeps Neutral with a $15 target, 3.7% above the $14.46 close.

earnings_insights: SOFI 3Q26 reported 10/27: adj revenue $1,371mn vs consensus $1,264mn (about 8% ahead, Visible Alpha) and GS est $1,284mn. Total revenue was $1,385mn.
SOFI 3Q26 reported: net interest income $929mn vs consensus $853mn and GS est $870mn. Non-interest income $456mn vs consensus $419mn.
SOFI 3Q26 reported: adjusted EBITDA $470mn vs consensus $443mn (6% ahead) and GS est $423mn. GAAP net income $241mn vs consensus $227mn.
SOFI 3Q26 reported GAAP diluted EPS $0.18 vs consensus $0.17 and GS est $0.15. GS describes it as slightly ahead of consensus.
SOFI 3Q26 reported total loan originations $16.9bn vs consensus $14.4bn and GS est $14.8bn. Personal loans were $12.6bn, student $2.9bn, home $1.4bn.

SOFI company FY26 guidance (raised): adjusted net revenue ~$5.04bn vs consensus $4,882mn, adjusted EBITDA ~$1.66bn vs consensus $1,628mn, adjusted net income ~$840mn vs consensus $807mn, adjusted EPS ~$0.61 vs consensus $0.59.
SOFI company FY26 guidance implies 4Q26 net revenue of about $1,376mn vs consensus $1,332mn, adjusted EBITDA about $492mn vs consensus $488mn, and EPS about $0.19, in line with consensus $0.19.

SOFI company initial FY27 guidance: net revenue ~$6.4bn vs consensus $6,054mn, adjusted EBITDA ~$2.24bn vs consensus $2,115mn, net income ~$1.28bn vs consensus $1,141mn, EPS ~$0.90 vs consensus $0.82.
GS estimates after the print: FY26E EPS $0.57, FY27E $0.74, FY28E $0.84. Quarterly EPS estimates are $0.15 for 9/26E, $0.19 for 12/26E and $0.19 for 3/27E.
